verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs say teams can "work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform," and there is an 'Selecting an Audit Partner' doc page, so in-platform auditor collaboration is a claimed capability. Nothing in the pack describes a scoped auditor role or view of controls and evidence, or how evidence is shared with the auditor. missing for 10: a documented scoped auditor role/permissions, an auditor-facing view of controls and evidence, a description of the evidence-sharing workflow replacing email/PDF exchange, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs

citations.quote: Collaborative tooling: Assign tasks, set deadlines, and work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform.
